name: Petra
description: An ancient city carved into rose-red rock cliffs, one of the world's most famous archaeological sites.

name: Wadi Rum
description: A vast desert wilderness known for its dramatic sandstone mountains and ancient petroglyphs.

name: Dead Sea
description: The lowest point on Earth, famous for its salt-rich waters where you can float effortlessly.

name: Jerash
description: One of the best preserved Roman cities in the world, featuring grand colonnaded streets and temples.

name: Rainbow Street
description: A vibrant street in Jabal Amman filled with cafes, art galleries, and local shops.

name: Jordan Museum
description: The national museum of Jordan housing artifacts including the Dead Sea Scrolls and ancient treasures.

name: Amman Citadel
description: An ancient hilltop site overlooking Amman with ruins spanning thousands of years of history.

name: Aqaba Marine Park
description: A stunning coral reef reserve perfect for snorkeling and diving in the Red Sea.

name: Al-Husseini Mosque
description: One of the oldest and most prominent mosques in Amman, a beautiful example of Islamic architecture.
openHours: Open daily (closed during prayer times for visitors)

name: Ajloun Castle
description: A 12th-century Arab Islamic castle built to defend against the Crusaders, surrounded by lush pine forests.
